title: Training Seminar on “Fahmul Quran” Organized by the Department of Islamic Studies
text:
Training Seminar on “Fahmul Quran”

February 11, 2026 | 02:00 PM

Department of Islamic Studies

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

A training seminar/workshop on the subject of
Fahmul Quran
was held
on February 11, 2026, at 02:00 PM in the Department of Islamic Studies,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.

The seminar was organized under the supervision of

Prof. Dr. Karim Dad
, Chairperson, Department of Islamic Studies.
Faculty members of the department actively participated in the session.

On this occasion,
Prof. Dr. Abzahir Khan
and

Dr. Muhammad Zakariyya
delivered comprehensive lectures on
various aspects of
Fahmul Quran
, highlighting its academic
significance and practical application in understanding the Holy Quran.
The speakers engaged the participants with scholarly insights and encouraged
interactive discussion.

The workshop provided an opportunity for faculty members to enhance their
understanding of the subject and to strengthen academic engagement within
the department.

The Department of Islamic Studies continues to organize such scholarly
activities to promote academic excellence and professional development.
